name: wpcpm/administrator-dashboard
title: Administrator Dashboard
description: Shows Administrators what needs them, then the cards in three groups: Waiting for you (institution applications, Collaboration Agreements, semester reports, mentor requests, sponsor applications, sponsor posts to review, sponsor offers to review, events, Sponsor Collaboration Agreements and sponsor reports), Watch (offers running low, duplicated students, new interests, sponsor terms ending, and syncs and health) and Reference (sponsors, programs running and mentor engagement).
